label: Bible Study
prompt: Honour all men. Love the _____. Fear God. Honour the king.
verse: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
note: Four quick commands — honour everyone, love the church, fear God, honour the king.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the _____ of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
verse: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
note: God doesn't just call us — He calls us into fellowship with His Son, and He's faithful to see it through.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Yet Michael the _____, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
verse: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
note: Even Michael the archangel wouldn't trade insults with the devil — he just said, 'The Lord rebuke thee.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my _____ with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
verse: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
note: Paul's farewell to the Ephesian elders: chains awaited in Jerusalem, and he only cared about finishing well.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Many shall be _____, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
verse: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
note: In the end 'many shall be purified, and made white, and tried' — and only the wise shall understand.
